fine_lines.title: talk vs speak
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان بمعنى «يتكلم» وتُستخدمان غالبًا بنفس المعنى. talk أكثر للمحادثة بين شخصين أو أكثر وللمواقف غير الرسمية (مع الأصدقاء والعائلة). speak أكثر للكلام من طرف واحد (محاضرة)، وللمواقف الرسمية، وللتعبير عن معرفة اللغات (I speak Arabic)، وفي الطلبات المهذبة (May I speak to...?).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean to say words, and often you can use either. Talk is usually for conversations between people and informal situations. Speak is usually for one-way talks like presentations, formal situations, language ability (I speak Arabic), and polite requests (May I speak to...?).

examples.sentence: Are you talking to yourself again?
I was talking to Pete on the phone.
May I speak to the manager, please?

fine_lines.title: unique vs one-of-a-kind
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى متقارب: شيء لا يوجد مثله. one-of-a-kind تُستخدم غالبًا قبل الاسم: a one-of-a-kind piece.
fine_lines.explanation_en: They mean almost the same: there is nothing else like it. One-of-a-kind is often used before a noun: a one-of-a-kind piece.

examples.sentence: Local artists made these one-of-a-kind pieces.

grammar.title: Talk or speak?
grammar.explanation_ar: talk و speak كلاهما بمعنى يتكلم. استخدم talk في: 1) المحادثة بين شخصين أو أكثر (talk to/with someone). 2) المواقف غير الرسمية بين الأصدقاء والعائلة. استخدم speak في: 1) الكلام من طرف واحد كالخطاب أو المحاضرة. 2) المواقف الرسمية (المدير يتحدث مع الموظفين). 3) القدرة على لغة: I speak English. 4) الطلبات المهذبة: Could I speak to Sue, please? وفي الدرس معنى مجازي: It speaks to me = يعجبني ويلامس قلبي.
grammar.explanation_en: Talk and speak both mean to say words. Use talk for: 1) conversations between people (talk to/with someone); 2) informal situations with friends and family. Use speak for: 1) one-way talks like speeches; 2) formal situations; 3) language ability: I speak English; 4) polite requests: Could I speak to Sue, please? Also a special meaning: It speaks to me = I feel a connection to it.
examples: Are you talking to yourself again?
From the way he was speaking, I don't think he likes cake.
He'll never speak to you again.
Pick some trash that speaks to you.
